'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals John Anderson DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Casa Bonita!
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
